title: AS-REP Roasting
description: Accounts configured with "Do not require Kerberos pre-authentication" allow any unauthenticated attacker to request an AS-REP message whose encrypted portion is derived from the account's password hash. This material can be subjected to offline password cracking. Enumeration of vulnerable accounts is possible without valid credentials.
businessImpact: High --- compromise of an affected account provides an initial foothold in the domain and may expose privileged access if the account is a member of sensitive groups.
remediation:
- Enable Kerberos pre-authentication for all accounts unless a documented, compensating control exists.
- Enforce strong, long passwords on any account that cannot use pre-authentication.
- Audit the userAccountControl attribute for the DONT\_REQ\_PREAUTH flag.
- Monitor for AS-REQ requests with pre-authentication disabled (Event ID 4768).
